CheckTitle: Config (RMS) compliance rules are configured and enabled
Description: Ensure that Config (RMS) compliance rules (policy assignments) are configured and enabled to monitor resource configuration compliance.
Risk: Without compliance rules configured, the Config service cannot evaluate resources against desired configurations. Security misconfigurations such as unencrypted storage, public access, or missing MFA may go undetected.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Resource Management Service (RMS).
3. Go to Compliance > Resource compliance.
4. Click Create Assignment.
5. Select built-in policy definitions or create custom rules.
6. Configure the rule parameters and enable the assignment.
7. Click OK.

Recommendation.Text: Configure and enable compliance rules in Config (RMS) to monitor resource configuration compliance.
